title: Would You Be Impressed?
lyrics:
[00:05.94]Would you be upset if I told you we were dying?
[00:09.69]And every cure they gave us was a lie?
[00:13.25]Oh! They mean it when they say we're dead and doomed
[00:16.40]And every single symptom brings us closer to the tomb
[00:19.22]And who will take the credit for our swift impending fall
[00:22.68]Because it's not my fault
[00:25.73]Would you be impressed if I said that the dead would help us counting
[00:29.88]Every single moment that we waste our time?
[00:33.05]All the time we're spending vaccinating this disease
[00:35.84]I just get dizzy when I think of all the ways we try to hide our maladies
[00:39.98]We wine, we dine, and everything is fine
[00:42.57]Because it's not my fault
[00:59.15]Now you're upset because you finally got the notion
[01:02.86]That everything you had is spinning down the drain
[01:06.07]Oh! Do you mean it when you beg and pray and plead?
[01:09.46]Your "Give it to me, give it to me, give it to me, give it to me all those things we need"
[01:12.76]And what, pray tell, will you whimper when your number will be called
[01:15.52]You'll say "It's not my fault"
[02:05.79]Go! Now! The others they'll await you
[02:09.03]And every single one among the lot of you will have your turn
[02:12.45]Ai, ai, ai, oh, oh, oh
[02:15.44]Like moths that fly into the flame it always ends up so
[02:18.88]You scream, "Not me! Take anybody else!
[02:21.84]Because it's not my fault!"
[02:44.92]I had a dream last night where everyone was trying
[02:48.54]Subconsciously I knew it was a lie
[02:52.30]And when I woke I knew it was time to pray
[02:55.28]To make amends before the end, before my judgement day
[02:58.17]I looked around, I stood alone, I knew what I had to say
[03:01.32]I said "It's all my fault"
